reply.emotion: warm, lazy, and bright, full of sunshine and freedom
notes: In literary contexts, the word 'лето' can sometimes be used to mean 'year,' such as 'мне двадцать лет' (I am twenty years old), though this is more often seen in set phrases related to age.

senses.definition: The warmest season of the year, between spring and autumn.
A period of twelve months, often used when counting age or historical duration.
